key_insight: HDMAC molecular microcrystals can self-heal microscale damage while retaining optical waveguiding and resonator properties relevant to lasing.
engineering_relevance: Self-healing organic crystal resonators could improve the reliability and longevity of miniaturized photonic devices.
method: Induce microscale cracks and complete fractures using an AFM cantilever tip.
Examine healing along the (010) and (001) crystallographic planes.
Assess recovery using optical loss, resonator characteristics, and nanomechanical analyses.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports crack healing in two crystal orientations and evaluates structural and photonic recovery, but provides no numerical healing efficiencies.
watch_item: Healing conditions, repeat-cycle durability, and post-healing lasing performance are not specified in the abstract.
paper_title: Fracture Mechanics and Self-Healing in Molecular Crystal Resonators for Lasing
